lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 9 vertical white lines traverse the dark torso. Spacing is relatively uniform in the mid-section, with wider gaps between the two anterior-most lines.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The posterior-most line is abbreviated and dashed. The two anterior-most lines are truncated, terminating before reaching the lower ventral boundary of the torso.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Two high-contrast white spots are located on the posterior flank, positioned superior to the hind limb joint.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: The two spots on the posterior flank exhibit horizontal spatial alignment but do not form a continuous geometric line.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Horns exhibit a spiral-lyrate curvature, projecting dorsoposteriorly from the frontal bone with a lateral flare followed by a medial convergence at the tips.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The estimated pixel distance between terminal tips is approximately 2.3 times the width of a single horn base.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: High-contrast ivory tipping accounts for approximately 10% of the total visible horn length.

other_distinctive_markers: Distinctive white dorsal crest/fringe; white facial markings including a prominent inter-orbital chevron and two circular cheek spots; white bands on lower limbs transitioning into tan distal segments.
